value: **Involvement**: Teachers collaborated as design partners in collaborative design sessions to provide pedagogical domain expertise, define requirements, evaluate usability, and iteratively refine educational technology tools and online learning environments. **Evidence**: "For example, in co-design projects with educators and youth, students engage in creative problem-solving and media production, positioning them as knowledge-makers whose ideas actively shape the learning environment."
